positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Key member of an engineering team tasked with the development of a modern web application built on .NET, Backbone.js, Angular.js, SASS/COMPASS, HTML5, and CSS3.

Lead the integration of the AngularJs and testing frameworks in our web product ‘s development workflow.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported software solutions using Microsoft technologies (ASP.NET, WCF, .NET, SQL Server, etc...) and SOA's technology (Policy Manager)

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed .NET Web and Web Service, Reporting Services,  SQL Database, SharePoint,  and InfoPath solutions for Nike Corporation.
- Supported existing Nike ASP.NET  Web, SharePoint, and SQL applications
- Configured Microsoft Office SharePoint Server (MOSS) , Internet Information Services (IIS), and SQL Report Servers (SSRS)
- Managed deployment process.
- Supported a Nike system containing NPV PowerView 5.0 Databases, SQL 2000 Databases,  DTS Packages, SQL Analysis 2000 Cubes, MS Excel 2003 Pivot Tables, and an ASP.NET Web Application.

Skills:   C#, ASP.NET Web Application, Web Service, Windows Workflow,  ADO.NET,  HTML,  JavaScript, JQuery, LINQ to SQL, XML, T-SQL, SQL Reporting Services, MicroStrategy Reporting,  SQL Server Database, SQL Analysis, InfoPath Form, SharePoint Administration and Solution (SmartParts and Contents), Build and Deployment ( Windows Server 2003 and IIS 6),  Application and System Support, and Windows Server 2003 Administration.

positions.title: e-Gov Intern/Contractor
positions.description: Developed the Oregon Progress Board's Benchmark Reporting web application (http://benchmarks.oregon.gov)

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Research Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted Artificial Intelligence (AI) researchers at OSU in researching and designing an AI agent that can learn and reason in complex military applications. The military application domain that we focused on was the Air Tasking Order (ATO) Planning domain.

Skills: 	LISP, Game Development, Research.
